title: Kinglet
blurb: The kinglets or crests are small birds in the family Regulidae.
facts: This family has representatives in Eurasia and North America.
There are six species in this family; one, the Madeira firecrest, was only recently split from the common firecrest as a separate species.
The ruby-crowned kinglet differs sufficiently in its voice and plumage to be afforded its own genus, Corthylio.
